# David Packer Recommends Handstand Push-Ups And Dips As A Starting Point For Planche

David Packer recommends handstand push-ups and dips as the starting exercises for progressing toward the planche. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Details

- He would focus on handstand push-ups, dips, and hollow body straight body dips with forward lean for beginner students. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- After about two months, his beginner students could do five to ten second advanced tuck planche, coming from no tuck planche before. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- He recommends starting with half range of motion handstand push-ups or pike push-ups if needed, building up to five to ten full range of motion reps. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]
- For progressing from advanced tuck to straddle planche, he advises just keep grinding those handstand push-ups and focus on the basics, get stupid strong at them. [src: vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ]

## Evidence

- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "handstand push-ups would be and handstand push-ups dips but there are two types of dips i'll focus on weighted dips the regular ones and then it would be hollow body um straight body dips with forward lean those were the two or three exercises that i always got my uh beginner students to do"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "and that got them to at a certain level like you know wall handstand push-ups they could do i think it was like five to ten second advanced tuck after about two months or so which is pretty good you know coming from you saw you see a lot of guys that don't even have you know a tuck planche"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "i'd have handstand push-ups down half start off with half rom do pike if you need to at the beginning build up to you know reps of you know five full rom and that's pretty that's really a pretty good level like you know five to ten full rom"
- vid-lkcLJc2c0NQ (David Packer): "i'll just keep grinding those handstand push-ups and like you can you don't need to do all these dynamics where it's like you know advanced top to straddle and then you go back and then you know there's reps like that"
